summary: Iteration 4 validation of (A) AI blocker analysis cache, (B) POD tabs Overall/Trinity/Manual/People/Changes with RunsSummaryCards + TrinityMatrix + ManualFunnel, and (C) new attention rule. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py from 42 -> 48 tests, ALL 48 PASS. New coverage: TestPhaseSummary (Aniket Soni Engram total=20 with buckets block=9/run=2/stale=9, total_row sums correctly, rows keyed engram/forge/crucible with all 6 phase buckets, manual pipeline dict has people/assigned/bundles_created/bundles_approved/trajectory/qced ints); TestBlockerCache (Ram Lalit Chaudhary — cached blocker_analysis returned on GET, generated_at identical across two GETs → NOT regenerated on load); TestAttentionRule (overview metrics.attention=32 in the expected 20-40 window matching new rule; /api/users?attention=true returns only people with is_attention=true AND has_trinity=False AND has_manual=False AND not on Leave; a Trinity worker has is_attention=false; all absent/leave users have is_attention=false). Frontend E2E as admin: /pods/Aniket%20Soni renders default 'overall' tab; tab bar exposes exactly [pod-tab-overall, pod-tab-trinity, pod-tab-manual, pod-tab-people, pod-tab-changes]. Overall tab shows pod-overview-insight banner, KPI cards, pod-counts (5 cells), a 'Runs & Phase Status' block with overall-runs (Engram/Forge/Crucible run cards) + overall-matrix (headers AREA/TOTAL RUNS/BLOCK/RUN/SHIP/HOLD/STALE/IDLE with 4 rows Engram=20 9 2 0 0 9 0, Forge=2 0 1 1 0 0 0, Crucible=0..., Total=22 9 3 1 0 9 0) + overall-manual funnel, blocker-analysis card, DistroCharts, and pod-member-insights list. Trinity tab: trinity-runs + trinity-matrix + pod-trinity-table with all Trinity columns + 'No data' for blanks + Attention badges. Manual tab: manual-funnel + pod-manual-status + pod-manual-table. People + Changes tabs render. AI cache UX: opening /pods/Ram%20Lalit%20Chaudhary auto-renders blocker-result WITHOUT any click (headline '22 of 23 people (95.7%) are stuck on Trinity with no communication about blockers, blocking 4.3% completion.' + blockers with counts). Regression: /overview attention=32 (matches new rule) with 'Fresh · just now' state; /tpms table has 0 progressbars and integer columns (Prafful Gupta 106 5 3 86 3 3 5 6 7). Reporting date 2026-09-17, 333 people.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1020 lines mixing auth+sync+queries+phase_summary+LLM route; extract phase_summary/analysis into a module (also aids testability).
CORS: allow_credentials=True with allow_origins fallback '*' when CORS_ORIGINS env is unset — still open.
POST /api/pods/{name}/analyze remains open to viewer role and has no rate-limit/debounce; a viewer can trigger LLM credit spend. Consider require_admin or per-pod-per-minute cap.

blocker_analyses cache is keyed by (pod, reporting_date) via update_one filter but the stored doc also includes revision; if a mid-day revision changes remarks, the cached analysis is silently stale until re-run. Consider auto-invalidation when revision increments.

compute_phase_summary derives 'Total Runs' from displayed people/items count because run_count columns are blank in the current sheet; expected per review note, but the column header 'TOTAL RUNS' could be renamed to 'ITEMS' / 'PEOPLE' to avoid confusion if run_count stays unavailable long-term.

_disp_bucket falls back to _phase_bucket when disposition is blank; the two heuristics can classify differently for the same person on different areas. Consider surfacing the source (phase vs disposition) in the payload for debugging.
seed_data_creation: None. Live baseline 2026-09-17 (333 people / 15 PODs / 4 TPMs). Reused cached analyses for Aniket Soni / Vidit Sharma / Ram Lalit Chaudhary; test_analyze_vidit_sharma_and_cache issues one fresh LLM call.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 added TestPhaseSummary, TestBlockerCache, TestAttentionRule. Attention count on the current baseline is 32 (window 20-40 tolerated). Frontend selectors: pod-tab-{overall,trinity,manual,people,changes}; overall-runs, overall-matrix, overall-manual, trinity-runs, trinity-matrix, manual-funnel, pod-manual-status, pod-trinity-table, pod-manual-table, pod-people-table, blocker-analysis, blocker-result, run-blocker-analysis. Cached PODs with existing blocker_analysis to test 'auto-render on load': Aniket Soni, Vidit Sharma, Ram Lalit Chaudhary.
